Sandbox_Remanescentes_MaxActive: Max survivors with a body at once
Sandbox_Remanescentes_MaxActive_tooltip: How many survivors can be physically present near you at the same time. The rest keep living off-screen.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_NPCDamageMultiplie: Multiplies weapon damage dealt by survivors to zombies.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_ZombieDamage_toolt: Health removed from a survivor per zombie attack.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_DebugMenu_tooltip: Shows the 'Remanescentes' right-click menu to spawn and command survivors. Useful for testing.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_ZombieSightRange_t: Tiles at which a zombie can spot a survivor in daylight. Halved at night, reduced when sneaking, increased when running.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_NPCNoiseMultiplier: Scales the noise survivors make when fighting and running (attracts zombies). 0 = silent.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_FleeHealthPercent_: Survivors run away from zombies when their health drops below this. 0 = never flee.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_Barks_tooltip: Short lines when spotting zombies, killing, getting hurt, fleeing and idling.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_ZombieAttackMode_t: Real: zombies use their own attack AI against survivors (experimental). Simulated: lunge animation plus scripted damage.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_NPCVsPlayerDamage: Hostile survivor damage to the player
Sandbox_Remanescentes_NPCVsPlayerDamage_: Multiplies weapon wounds hostile survivors inflict on you. Their hits cut and scratch, never infect.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_WorldGroups_toolti: Groups living in real buildings around you. New ones appear over time while below this number.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_RaiderPercent_tool: Share of new groups that are hostile raiders.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_ScavengeDeathChanc: Chance that an off-screen scavenging trip costs a group member.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_LootLeftPercent_to: Chance each container in a building looted by a group still has its items.
